p2LEDInit.summary: Configures a WS2812 RGB buffer for the selected user pin and pixel count.
prerequisites: Import P2 LEDs and its declared dependencies.
inputs: 1. P2 WS2812 init pin: number; library example 8.

examples.title: Use P2 WS2812 init pin … pixels …
examples.explanation: Block notation: Configures a WS2812 RGB buffer for the selected user pin and pixel count. Command; 1 through 128 pixels, RGBW unsupported.

notes: Candidate extension-9 firmware required; not in the reviewed revision-8 installer. Optional WS2812 RGB strip. Explicit user pin, 1-128 pixels. No output until update. Brightness 0-255 scales retained colors. RGBW unsupported. Hardware acceptance pending.
Source: boards\propeller2\integration\libraries\P2 LEDs.ubl. Examples are illustrative block notation, not hardware acceptance tests.

p2LEDSet.summary: Changes one retained RGB color without transmitting the strip yet.
prerequisites: Import P2 LEDs and its declared dependencies.

examples.title: Use P2 LED … color …
examples.explanation: Block notation: Changes one retained RGB color without transmitting the strip yet. Command; LED index starts at 1.

examples.title: Show a dim red first pixel
examples.code:
P2 WS2812 init pin [8] pixels [8]
P2 LEDs brightness [16] (0-255)
P2 LEDs fill [0]
P2 LED [1] color [16711680]
P2 LEDs update
examples.explanation: Use this only with an attached correctly powered strip and an available pin 8. The buffer changes do not appear until update; low brightness limits current.

notes: Candidate extension-9 firmware required; not in the reviewed revision-8 installer. Optional WS2812 RGB strip. Explicit user pin, 1-128 pixels. No output until update. Brightness 0-255 scales retained colors. RGBW unsupported. Hardware acceptance pending.
Source: boards\propeller2\integration\libraries\P2 LEDs.ubl. Examples are illustrative block notation, not hardware acceptance tests.
